New blocks in this board: USB-C sink + ESD, 3.3 V regulator, ESP32-S3 + reset and boot bias, BOOT / RESET buttons, I2C expansion header. They stay labelled unreviewed until they are promoted.

Provides native USB CDC help and commands, initializes 100 kHz I2C with a finite timeout, and scans sensor addresses at startup and on request without starting Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. A model wrote this firmware and it has only been compiled, so read it before you flash it.

sections.title: USB-C power and native USB
sections.purpose: Accept 5 V power and provide programming and serial data.
notes: Separate 5.1 kOhm pull-downs on CC1 and CC2 identify a USB-C sink. Use a known 5 V source advertising at least 1.5 A; no USB PD negotiation or CC current detection is provided.
USBLC6-2SC6 protects D+ and D-; its VBUS reference connects to 5 V. Series resistors are 22 Ohm, placed near the MCU.
Native USB uses GPIO19 D- and GPIO20 D+. Use a data-capable cable; full-load power is not guaranteed from an arbitrary legacy host.

reference.quote: USB 2.0 port application diagram using USBLC6-2

sections.title: 3.3 V regulator
sections.purpose: Convert USB 5 V to the MCU and sensor supply.
notes: AP2112K-3.3 uses 1 uF ceramic input and output capacitors, with EN tied to input.
600 mA electrical peak rating covers the 500 mA MCU plus 50 mA sensor allowance. Continuous total load must stay at or below 250 mA at 25 C ambient; 600 mA is not a continuous thermal guarantee.
At 5.25 V input and 250 mA continuous load, dissipation is approximately 0.49 W; with 184 C/W junction rise is approximately 90 C. Lower continuous load is required at higher ambient temperature.

sections.title: ESP32-S3 module
sections.purpose: Run application firmware and control the I2C sensor bus.
notes: Use one ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8 module with 8 MB flash and integrated antenna.
Supply bypass is 22 uF plus 100 nF. EN has a 10 kOhm / 1 uF startup delay. GPIO0 is pulled high; GPIO45 and GPIO46 are pulled low for safe boot straps.
I2C SDA is GPIO8 and SCL is GPIO9. Reserve GPIO19 and GPIO20 for native USB.
Keep the module antenna region clear of other components and copper on both layers.

reference.quote: This is the typical application circuit of the module connected with peripheral components

sections.title: BOOT and RESET buttons
sections.purpose: Allow manual reset and entry to the ROM download loader.
notes: RESET shorts EN to ground. BOOT shorts GPIO0 to ground.
Hold BOOT, press and release RESET, then release BOOT to enter download mode. Bias resistors and EN delay are in the MCU section.

sections.title: 3.3 V I2C sensor connector
sections.purpose: Connect one external low-power I2C sensor.
notes: Four-pin JST-SH connector: pin 1 GND, pin 2 3.3 V, pin 3 SDA, pin 4 SCL.
SDA and SCL each have a 10 kOhm pull-up to 3.3 V. Use a short cable and 100 kHz I2C; verify rise time for the attached sensor and cable.
External sensor allowance is 50 mA maximum, subject to the total continuous regulator limit of 250 mA. No 5 V logic or external power injection is supported.
